thread:
maya: Starting a traffic-watch for gatekeeper_v2 now — phased rollout 1% -> 5% -> 25%. 10m observation windows. Posting async updates here, please ping if you see anything odd.

sam: Saw a tiny latency blip in the first 2m, looks recovered. will keep an eye on p95.

sam: logs I'm tailing: ```kubectl -n inference logs deploy/gatekeeper-v2 --since=5m | tail -n 60```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: gatekeeper_v2 deployment started (build: 2026.03.17-42). slice=1% created. CI: ✅

nico: Quick Q — rollback path? Is the feature-flag toggle instant for traffic slices or do we need to do a full deploy revert? I can run `./tools/ffctl set gatekeeper_v2 0%` or `/ff toggle gatekeeper_v2 off` — which is the canonical command?

alex: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gatekeeper-rollout — rollback is via ffctl. recommended command: `ffctl set gatekeeper_v2 0% --reason "auto-rollback"`. Also PR #4556 has the traffic-safety backoff fix, @maya can you merge when ready?

linda: Monitoring: dashboards + alerts configured. Thresholds: error rate >0.5% OR p95 > 350ms -> page on-call. I'll be watching the incident channel.

maya: @alex merged PR and I bumped to 5% at t+17m. @nico rollback is instant via ffctl, good to go. If we need to force, I'll run `ffctl set gatekeeper_v2 0%`.

sam: Added a quick e2e snapshot for the rate limiter edge-case that showed up in staging. If that fails in canary I'll post the fail log here.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: gatekeeper_v2 promoted to 5% (timestamp: 2269876685).

maya: Update: at 5% now, p95 ≈ 220ms, error rate 0.12%. No anomalous 5xx spikes. Plan to promote to 25% after the next 10m window.

linda: ack :thumbsup: will page if thresholds crossed.

nico: Standing by for rollback, and left a CR ping on #git for the rate-limiter change — @sam can you take a look when you have a minute?

maya: Thanks everyone. If stable at 25% we'll close this thread. Ping me directly if you see anything that should trigger an immediate rollback.
